decisions.reason: Wood floor cleaning soap is a low-cost complementary care product that supports the parquet business and fits the established range.
Maintenance oil is a natural add-on sale for oiled parquet customers and takes few resources to keep listed.
A care product for oiled floors complements the flooring range and builds repeat purchases at low cost.
Underlay with moisture protection is a standard accessory sold alongside parquet installations, so it is worth retaining.
High density underlay foam rounds out the accessory offering and is likely a traded item with little downside to keeping it.
Oak parquet is core to a wood products firm's business and anchors the whole complementary product line.
